lines.en: label otohadorm5:
I knock on Otoha’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Otoha 的门，等她来开。

lines.en: I’ve gotten to spend time with her at[school] and in the park before, but...
lines.zh: 我之前已经在[school]和公园里跟她待过，不过……

lines.en: The two of us haven't really gotten to be alone in her dorm without any interference from others yet.
lines.zh: 我们俩还从没真正在她的宿舍里独处过——不被别人打扰的那种。

lines.en: Not that I expect anything exciting to happen, but she’s proven to be excitingly...normal by now.
lines.zh: 倒不是说期待会发生什么刺激的事，只是她到现在为止都……正常得令人欣喜。

lines.en: And, given that I spend my life surrounded by people like Molly and Tsuneyo and Ayane and...
lines.zh: 毕竟我这辈子身边围着的全是 Molly、Tsuneyo、Ayane 这种人……

lines.en: Well, you get the point.
lines.zh: 嗯，你懂的。

lines.en: There are a lot of strange girls in my class.
lines.zh: 我们班上的怪女孩实在太多了。

lines.en: So I shall wait patiently for this one particular outlier to answer.
lines.zh: 所以我就耐心等着这位格外特殊的另类来开门吧。

lines.en: I can no longer be patient.
lines.zh: 我再也耐心不下去了。

lines.en: : Otoha, are you in there?
lines.zh: : Otoha，你在里面吗？

lines.en: : Mmph! Unn...sec!
lines.zh: : 呜姆！嗯……等下！

lines.en: : ...What?
: Mngh. Sorry! I was eating.
lines.zh: : 呜嗯。抱歉！我在吃东西。

lines.en: : Door’s open.
lines.zh: : 门没锁。

lines.en: scene black
I walk into the room and kick my shoes off at the door, hoping that I’ll wind up staying here for at least an hour or two so I don’t have to awkwardly put them back on after like five minutes.
lines.zh: 我走进房间，在门口把鞋踢掉，希望自己至少能在这儿待上一两个小时，免得待了五分钟就得尴尬地把鞋穿回去。

lines.en: That has happened before and it has not been enjoyable.
lines.zh: 这种事以前发生过，一点也不好受。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm1
: Heeeeeey...
: Isn’t it a little late for you to be coming over?
lines.zh: : 你这会儿过来是不是有点晚了？

lines.en: : I’m already in relax-mode.
lines.zh: : 我已经切换到放松模式了。

lines.en: : You look very comfortable.
lines.zh: : 你看起来很舒服嘛。

lines.en: : And hungry.
lines.zh: : 而且很饿。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm2
: Hahah...yeah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是啊……

lines.en: : Nodoka’s at some bookstore with Futaba tonight and Rin’s playing some game with her other friends, so I figured I’d just...do my own thing.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 今晚跟 Futaba 去了书店，Rin 在跟她别的朋友玩游戏，所以我想……就自己干点自己的事吧。

lines.en: : And your own thing is gorging yourself on doughnuts and-
lines.zh: : 而你的「自己的事」就是猛吃甜甜圈，还有——

lines.en: : Wait, is that the sausage fest?
lines.zh: : 等等，那是香肠宴？

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm3
: I was curious, okay?! You made it sound so...sausagey!
lines.zh: : 我只是好奇嘛，行不行？！你说得它听起来好……好香肠！

lines.en: : Otoha’s first sausage fest...and I get to be here for it.
lines.zh: : Otoha 的第一次香肠宴……而我有幸在场。

lines.en: : Niki would be so proud...
lines.zh: : Niki 一定会很骄傲的……

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm4
: Do you want something or are you just here to try and embarrass me?
lines.zh: : 你是有什么事，还是专门来让我难堪的？

lines.en: : Just thought I’d come see what you were up to.
lines.zh: : 只是想过来看看你在忙什么。

lines.en: : You look nice with your hair down, by the way.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，你把头发放下来挺好看的。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm5
: Yeah? Thank you.
lines.zh: : 是吗？谢谢。

lines.en: : I really only put it up because I friggin' hate how it feels when the wind pushes it into my eyes.
lines.zh: : 我扎起来只是因为我他妈讨厌风把头发吹进眼睛里的感觉。

lines.en: : Surprised it’s not like, too red for you or whatever.
lines.zh: : 还以为你会嫌它太红之类的。

lines.en: : I mean, Ami’s hair is completely red and I haven’t gotten fed up with that yet.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，Ami 的头发可是一点不掺假的红，我也还没受够呢。

lines.en: : Yeah but Ami’s hair is cute and mine is just...hair.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，可 Ami 的头发可爱，我的就只是……头发。

lines.en: : Yes. Your hair {i}is{/i} hair.
lines.zh: : 对。你的头发{i}确实是{/i}头发。

lines.en: : Yeah, see? You get it.
lines.zh: : 对吧，你看？你懂的。

lines.en: I don’t.
lines.zh: 我不懂。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm6
: Do you want a doughnut?
lines.zh: : 你要吃甜甜圈吗？

lines.en: : I’ll probably eat all of them if you don’t take any and I don’t think my body will like that very much.
lines.zh: : 你要是不吃，我大概会把它们全吃掉，而我觉得我的身体不会太乐意。

lines.en: : No. But your heart will.
lines.zh: : 身体不会乐意，但你的心会。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 这到底什么意思？

lines.en: : It means that you should do whatever makes you happy. And if that means eating a box of doughnuts and two pounds of sausage noodles, so be it.
lines.zh: : 意思是，你想做什么就做什么。如果那意味着吃掉一盒甜甜圈和两磅香肠面，那就吃吧。

lines.en: : Welp, I did pay for all of it...so I might as well go to town.
lines.zh: : 唉，反正都是我付的钱……那就敞开吃吧。

lines.en: : Oh hey, are you good with technology by any chance? Because I can’t get this stupid TV to listen to me.
lines.zh: : 哦对了，你懂不懂电器什么的？我怎么都弄不动这台破电视。

lines.en: : What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : It’s just not doing anything when I press any of the buttons.
lines.zh: : 我按什么键它都没反应。

lines.en: : Maybe the remote is dead?
lines.zh: : 会不会是遥控器没电了？

lines.en: : The buttons on the TV aren’t working either. It’s just stuck on some weird picture.
lines.zh: : 电视上的按键也没用。它就卡在一幅奇怪的画面上。

lines.en: : I think it might be frozen.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它可能是死机了。

lines.en: : Have you tried turning it off and back on?
lines.zh: : 你试过关掉再打开吗？

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm7
: Just tell me you’re not good with this kind of stuff if you’re going to keep giving me generic tips.
lines.zh: : 你要是只会给这种通用建议，干脆直接说你不懂这个得了。

lines.en: : Hey, you would be surprised how many things can be fixed by turning them off and then back on.
lines.zh: : 嘿，有多少东西是靠关掉再打开就能修好的，你会惊讶的。

lines.en: : I {i}have{/i} tried that, Sensei. It’s just-
lines.zh: : 我{i}已经{/i}试过了，Sensei。它就是——

lines.en: : You know what? Never mind. I’ll just keep myself entertained by talking to the old guy in my room like everyone else does here.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。我就跟这屋里这个老爷子聊聊天解闷吧，反正这儿的人都这么干。

lines.en: I somehow manage to defeat a magical rectangle in the battle for a [young_girl]’s attention.
lines.zh: 我居然在一块神奇的矩形面前，赢下了争夺一个 [young_girl] 注意力的战争。

lines.en: I ascend.
lines.zh: 我升华了。

lines.en: : Couldn’t you have just played with Rin and the other girls? I’m pretty sure they’re right next door since Molly is like, the leader of their...game group or whatever.
lines.zh: : 你就不能跟 Rin 和其他女生一起玩吗？她们应该就在隔壁吧——Molly 好像算是她们那个……游戏小组的团长什么的。

lines.en: : I would have, but Rin seemed weirdly against me coming for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我本来想去的，可 Rin 不知为什么好像特别不希望我过去。

lines.en: : I’m not that close with any of the others yet anyway. She probably just wanted to avoid things being awkward.
lines.zh: : 我跟其他人也还不太熟。她大概只是不想场面尴尬吧。

lines.en: Or she wanted to avoid you thinking she’s a nerd...which sounds a lot closer to what Rin would do if she’s approaching Otoha the same way she approached Chika.
lines.zh: 又或者她不想让你觉得她是个书呆子……如果她接近 Otoha 的方式跟接近 Chika 时一样，那这倒更像 Rin 会干的事。

lines.en: : The game they play is kind of weird anyway. We’re better off in here.
lines.zh: : 反正她们玩的那个游戏也挺怪的。我们待在这儿更好。

lines.en: : Is it like, a video game or something?
lines.zh: : 那是像电子游戏之类的吗？

lines.en: : Not really. They all have these weird sheets of paper and talk in strange voices to one another.
lines.zh: : 不太像。她们都拿着些奇怪的纸，还用怪腔怪调互相说话。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm8
: Huh.
: Well that definitely doesn’t sound like any game I’ve ever played before.
lines.zh: : 那听起来确实不像我玩过的任何游戏。

lines.en: : Like I said, we’re better off in here where-
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，我们待在这儿更好，这里——

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm9
: SEVEN VIOLET FUNGUS APPEAR! ROLL FOR INITIATIVE!
lines.zh: : 七只紫色真菌出现了！投先攻！

lines.en: : Molly! Shh!
lines.zh: : Molly！嘘！

lines.en: : Like I was saying, we’re better off in here where it’s safe.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，我们待这儿更安全。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm10
: I guess you’re right.
lines.zh: : 你说得对吧。

lines.en: : Besides, I've barely eaten all day...so I should probably do that now anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说，我一整天都没怎么吃东西……所以现在也该吃了。

lines.en: : Well you...certainly have the required materials to do just that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你……确实备齐了这么做所需的材料。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm3
: I’m a growing girl, okay?! And if I don’t eat balanced meals, I’ll wind up looking all tired and dead inside like that one teacher Nodoka has the hots for!
lines.zh: : 我还在长身体好吗？！我要是不吃得均衡点，就会变得像 Nodoka 暗恋的那个老师一样，一脸疲惫、心如死灰！

lines.en: : The one that isn't you! The girl one! With the skirt!
lines.zh: : 不是你那个！是那个女的！穿裙子的！

lines.en: : What exactly is {i}balanced{/i} about your dinner, Otoha?
lines.zh: : Otoha，你这顿晚饭到底{i}均衡{/i}在哪儿了？

lines.en: : It’s got all the food groups! Sausage, pastry, soda! Come on, man!
lines.zh: : 所有食物种类都齐了！香肠、酥皮点心、汽水！拜托，老兄！

lines.en: : You have no idea what to do now that you have to provide food for yourself, do you?
lines.zh: : 现在得自己张罗吃的了，你完全不知道该怎么办，对吧？

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm11
: Well I obviously don’t think those are the real food groups, but...yeah.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道那些不是真正的食物种类，可是……嗯。

lines.en: : I’m used to my parents making dinner for me...so I’m stretching my wings and eating stuff that makes me happy instead of...green stuff.
lines.zh: : 我习惯了爸妈给我做晚饭……所以我现在正在展翅高飞，专吃让我开心的东西，而不是……绿色的东西。

lines.en: : You poor, lost soul.
lines.zh: : 你这可怜的、迷途的灵魂。

lines.en: : I’m sure I used to be just like you until I acquired a [niece].
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，在我有一个 [niece] 之前，我也跟你一模一样。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Let me just go out and get one of those really quick. Great advice.
lines.zh: : 哦，对啊。那我这就出去弄一个回来。真是个好建议。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm9
: Ahh!
: It’s just your phone, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 只是你的手机而已，Otoha。

lines.en: : You don’t actually get scared that easily, do you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会真这么容易被吓到吧？

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm12
: Of course not! I just...wasn’t ready for that.
lines.zh: : 当然不是！我只是……没准备好。

lines.en: : It surprised me.
lines.zh: : 它吓了我一跳。

lines.en: : So what you’re telling me is you...got scared.
lines.zh: : 所以你是在告诉我，你……被吓到了。

lines.en: : Shut up. I’ve gotta take this.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。我得接个电话。

lines.en: : Hold your ears closed and...don’t listen to what I say in case it’s some...super secret business or something.
lines.zh: : 把耳朵捂上……别听我说什么，万一是什么……超级机密的事呢。

lines.en: : Right...
scene black
Otoha grabs her phone and hops off of the bed, nearly killing the sausage fest in the process.
lines.zh: Otoha 抓起手机从床上跳下来，差点把香肠宴弄翻。

lines.en: Instead of exiting the room, which is what I expected her to do on account of telling me not to listen, she takes a seat on her stool and answers the call.
lines.zh: 我本以为她会走出房间——毕竟她刚让我别听——结果她却在凳子上坐下来，接起了电话。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm13
: Hello?...
: Yeah.
: Yeah. I’m eating fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我吃得挺好的。

lines.en: : You fucking liar.
lines.zh: : 你这个骗子。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm14
: Shh!
Otoha shushes me and whatever object has taken the place of my heart skips a beat.
lines.zh: Otoha 冲我「嘘」了一声，而那个取代了我心脏的东西漏跳了一拍。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm15
: Huh?!
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : No! You didn’t hear a boy just now! That was the TV!
lines.zh: : 不！你刚才没听到男生的声音！那是电视！

lines.en: : No, it really was! Listen!
lines.zh: : 不，真的是电视！你听！

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm16
: {i}Help me...{/i}
I decide to help Otoha by mimicking my favorite television program.
lines.zh: 我决定模仿我最喜欢的电视节目，来帮 Otoha 一把。

lines.en: : Take that, you little slut.
lines.zh: : 尝尝这个，你这个小骚货。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm17
: Sorry! My roommate just changed the channel on accident! I’m leaving the room now!
lines.zh: : 抱歉！我室友不小心换了台！我现在就出去！

lines.en: My favorite television program is highly pornographic, by the way.
lines.zh: 顺便说一句，我最喜欢的那个电视节目可是极其色情的。

lines.en: : No! I’m doing totally fine! I don’t need any money!
lines.zh: : 不！我过得很好！我不需要钱！

lines.en: : Yeah. Yeah,[school] is great.
lines.zh: : 嗯。嗯，[school] 挺好的。

lines.en: : My teacher?
lines.zh: : 我的老师？

lines.en: : Well, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm18
: He could be better.
lines.zh: : 他还可以更好。

lines.en: : What the fuck?
lines.zh: : 什么鬼？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Yeah.
: Okay.
: Love you too. Bye.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。再见。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm19
: How was your phone call?
lines.zh: : 你电话打得怎么样？

lines.en: : I invite you...into {i}my{/i} home...and offer you one of {i}my{/i} doughnuts...
lines.zh: : 我请你……进{i}我家{/i}……还把{i}我的{/i}甜甜圈分你一个……

lines.en: : And {i}this{/i} is how you repay me?
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}就是这样报答我的？

lines.en: : By mimicking a porno?
lines.zh: : 靠模仿色情片？

lines.en: : It has normal scenes as well. I just chose one of the racy ones.
lines.zh: : 它也有正常的桥段。我只是挑了段比较火辣的。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm20
: That was porn! I know porn when I hear it!
lines.zh: : 那就是色情片！是不是色情片我听得出来！

lines.en: : Do you?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yes but don’t misinterpret that!
lines.zh: : 是！但你别误会！

lines.en: : There’s really only one way to interpret that, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 这话真的只有一种解读方式，Otoha。

lines.en: : Sensei! That was my mom! You can’t just yell things like-
lines.zh: : Sensei！那是我妈！你不能就这么喊出那种——

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm21
: Oi! Quiet down in there! There are other people on this server, you know?!
lines.zh: : 喂！里面安静点！这个服务器上还有别人呢，知道吗？！

lines.en: : Ah! Sorry! Sorry!
lines.zh: : 啊！抱歉！抱歉！

lines.en: scene black
Otoha throws her phone onto the bed, once again almost killing the sausage fest, before moving past me and sitting back down.
lines.zh: Otoha 把手机扔到床上——又一次差点终结了香肠宴——然后从我身边挤过去，重新坐下。

lines.en: Just...this time, she looks a lot less pleased with me than she did when I first arrived.
lines.zh: 只是……这一次，她看我的眼神可比我刚来时要不爽多了。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm22
: If this is what having an older brother is like, I’m glad I was born an only child.
lines.zh: : 如果有哥哥就是这样，那我很庆幸自己是个独生女。

lines.en: : Oh come on. I’m sure that one day we’ll look back on this and laugh about it.
lines.zh: : 拜托。我敢肯定，总有一天我们回想起这件事会笑出来的。

lines.en: : Yeah. Totally. I can hear it now.
lines.zh: : 是啊。当然了。我现在就能听见了。

lines.en: : “Hey, remember when you called me a little slut while I was on the phone with my mom?”
lines.zh: : 「嘿，还记得我跟我妈打电话的时候，你叫我小骚货吗？」

lines.en: : “Hahaha. So funny.”
lines.zh: : 「哈哈哈。真好笑。」

lines.en: : In my defense, I was not calling {i}you{/i} a little slut. It was a line from the-
lines.zh: : 我得说句公道话，我不是在叫{i}你{/i}小骚货。那是里面的台词——

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Am I...in trouble?
lines.zh: : 我……是不是有麻烦了？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Seriously. Don’t do stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 说真的。别再干这种事了。

lines.en: : It’s nothing short of a miracle that I was even allowed to come live here.
lines.zh: : 我能被允许搬来这里住，简直就是个奇迹。

lines.en: : One wrong move and that could all come to an end. My parents know the address of this place and they could come get me at any moment.
lines.zh: : 只要走错一步，这一切就可能全部结束。我父母知道这儿的地址，他们随时都能来把我带走。

lines.en: : Oh great. I’m sure that’s not an omen for them to show up at the worst possible time in the future.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。我敢肯定这不会成为他们将来在最糟糕的时机出现的预兆。

lines.en: : There won’t {i}be{/i} a future if you keep doing stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 你要是继续这么干，那就{i}没有{/i}将来了。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm23
: I’ve obviously come around to hanging out in here with you if we're both bored, but please don’t do things that will make my leash even tighter.
lines.zh: : 我显然已经愿意在我们都无聊的时候让你来这儿玩了，但拜托你别做那些会让我的绳子勒得更紧的事。

lines.en: : Just take the leash off entirely and stop answering them.
lines.zh: : 那就干脆把绳子解了，别再接他们电话了。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm24
: Dude, no. They’re still my parents.
lines.zh: : 老兄，不行。他们毕竟是我父母。

lines.en: : Just be respectful and stay away from sex jokes while I’m talking to them. That’s all I want.
lines.zh: : 只要尊重一点，我跟他们通话的时候别开荤段子玩笑就行。我就这点要求。

lines.en: : And maybe 1,000 yen. That would be cool too.
lines.zh: : 还有，最好再给个 1000 日元。那样也不错。

lines.en: : You and this damn 1,000 yen. I literally just heard you tell your mom you didn’t need any money.
lines.zh: : 你和你这该死的 1000 日元。我刚刚才亲耳听见你跟你妈说你不需要钱。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm25
: Doesn’t mean I don’t {i}want{/i} any. Pay up, Sensei. It’s a fine for being a jerk.
lines.zh: : 不需要不代表我{i}不想要{/i}。掏钱吧，Sensei。这是你当混蛋的罚款。

lines.en: : I’ll give you 1,000 yen...but I need the doughnuts in return.
lines.zh: : 我可以给你 1000 日元……但我要甜甜圈作为交换。

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm26
: Wait, all of them?!
lines.zh: : 等等，全都要？！

lines.en: : I thought you didn’t want any!
lines.zh: : 你不是说不要吗！

lines.en: : It’s for your own good, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 这是为你好，Otoha。

lines.en: : Besides, once you try the sausage fest, you’ll never want to eat anything else ever again.
lines.zh: : 再说了，你一旦尝过香肠宴，就再也不会想吃别的东西了。

lines.en: : I already had a few bites.
lines.zh: : 我已经吃了几口了。

lines.en: : It’s...extremely average.
lines.zh: : 味道……极其普通。

lines.en: : {i}How dare you...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你怎么敢……{/i}

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm27
: Ugh. Keep your money. I’ll just eat my doughnuts and watch this weird picture of a house until-
lines.zh: : 唉。钱你留着吧。我就吃我的甜甜圈，看这幅奇怪的房子画面，直到——

lines.en: scene otohapajamdorm28
: Oh. The TV went back to normal.
lines.zh: : 哦。电视恢复正常了。

lines.en: : When did that happen?
lines.zh: : 什么时候的事？

lines.en: : Beats me. I’m glad things worked out, though.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。不过还好，总算解决了。

lines.en: : I was starting to think I may have ruined your night.
lines.zh: : 我还以为我把你的夜晚给毁了呢。

lines.en: : You did ruin my night, but I signed up for that when I invited you in.
lines.zh: : 你确实毁了我的夜晚，但我在请你进来的时候就已经认了。

lines.en: : I like this. This is good.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢这样。这样挺好。

lines.en: : Like what? What’s good?
lines.zh: : 喜欢什么？什么挺好的？

lines.en: : Us. You don’t let me walk all over you but you aren’t extremely abrasive in telling me to stop.
lines.zh: : 我们。你不会任由我骑在你头上，但让我停下来的时候也不算太冲。

lines.en: : Yeah, I just think you’re really annoying.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我只是觉得你特别烦人。

lines.en: : Now shush. I’m gonna watch TV and eat junk food all night and you can either hang out and deal with that or just get out.
lines.zh: : 现在闭嘴。我要通宵看电视吃垃圾食品，你要么留下忍着，要么就滚。

lines.en: : Understood. Move over.
lines.zh: : 明白。往那边挪挪。

lines.en: scene black
I take a seat next to Otoha and {i}do{/i} ultimately receive a doughnut.
lines.zh: 我在 Otoha 旁边坐下，最后{i}确实{/i}拿到了一个甜甜圈。

lines.en: She manages to finish the other three as well as the entire sausage fest, and I suddenly feel the urge to visit Maya and inform her that there may be someone else in the class who is just as good at eating as her.
lines.zh: 她把剩下三个甜甜圈和整份香肠宴都解决了，我突然很想去找 Maya，告诉她班上可能有个吃起东西来跟她不相上下的人。

lines.en: I don’t, though.
lines.zh: 不过我没去。

lines.en: Instead, I hang out and watch some reality show with Otoha until Nodoka gets home.
lines.zh: 而是留下来陪 Otoha 看了会儿真人秀，一直看到 Nodoka 回来。

lines.en: It was a surprisingly refreshing night, all things considered.
lines.zh: 总的来说，这是个意外清爽的夜晚。
